# Cozy Rainier Cabin

> Cozy Rainier Cabin is a creekside cabin for two at 155 Nisqually Way, Ashford, WA 98304, near Mount Rainier National Park's Nisqually entrance. It has one bedroom with a queen bed and one bathroom, and is booked through Airbnb.

## The cabin

- Sleeps 2 guests; 1 bedroom (queen bed), 1 bathroom, and a couch in the living room
- Wood-burning fireplace, creekside fire pit, and outdoor furniture
- Kitchen with stove, oven, microwave, refrigerator, freezer, coffee maker, and toaster
- Wifi, TV, heating, and a ceiling fan (no air conditioning, washer, or dryer)
- Free parking and an EV charger
- A park next door with a lake, frisbee golf, horseshoes, and a playground

## House rules

- 2 guests maximum
- Up to 2 pets allowed
- No smoking indoors ($250 fee)
